title: Dopamine Eggs
description:
Dopamine Eggs is a clicker idle game where you must earn many eggs...many....many eggs. This isn't just your basic idle game though, every single thing you buy in this game has it's own minigame. From leveling up your mage in RPG style, to fighting your way through the collectible card system. The ways you can earn eggs just never ends.

 

• Over 366 achievements to unlock

• World slowly builds itself from scratch the further you get

• Level up your mage and unlock different spells

• Summon collectible cards, characters featured from Eggys Games Flash Games in the past

• Fuse eggs in the lab with fusion mechanics

• Slowly unlock the deep lore of why this is happening

• Transcend space and time to unlock the secrets of the eggverse

• Explore alternative egg realities with different laws of the world

Explore the mage, 
He auto levels with eggteligence. You can choose his stats and cast spells that you unlock. Each time you transcend you can play him in slightly different ways. Unlock the mysterious egg helper to find his true gifts late game...

Summon Cards and Battle Them

Each card is a re-creation of over 20 years of Flash games that were made in the past. You will recognise characters from famous flash games such as Battle Fish, The Unfair Platformer, Smithy's Quest, Stickya Adventurya, Knights Castle and more! All added with a new spin to keep them fresh! every card has it's own unique spell.

 Over 366 Achievements to Earn!

So many achievements to earn all built into Steam, this will keep track of everything! and slowly unravel the deeper and darker eggs not known to humanity yet.... 
 

Never. Stop. Earning. Eggs.

They are the lifeforce. 

You will want more. Forever.
description_short: Dopamine Eggs is a next-generation clicker idle game where every upgrade unlocks a new way to play. Earn eggs through a huge variety of activities, from leveling up your mage in an RPG adventure to battling with a collectible card game! the ways to earn eggs are forever endless.
